assay: bulk RNA-seq (STAR 2.7.8a + RSEM 1.3.2 expected counts, GENCODE M25/mm10), skeletal muscle (tibialis anterior per FIG1C legend)
sample_inclusion: 2x2 factorial, n = 4 per group, 16 samples, all deposited (FIG1C: n = 4)
primary_estimand: Effect of 4 weeks of treadmill exercise training on skeletal-muscle gene expression in WT mice (trained vs untrained), and the same training effect in CHCHD4 Tg mice, whose comparison shows which training responses depend on CHCHD4 downregulation (S2.7.p5, Tables S4 and S5)
planned_contrasts: WT trained vs WT untrained (S2.7.p5; Table S4 by context; paper DEG count not available, supplementary table not in hand)
CHCHD4 Tg trained vs Tg untrained (S2.7.p5; Table S5 by context; count not available)
Tg vs WT within untrained and within trained (S2.1.p2, FIG1C volcano, Tables S1-S3) - genotype contrasts, not exercise effects; not run here

paper_threshold.source_locator: S4.3.8.p1 states no DEG cutoff; FIG1C draws a p = 0.01 display line on the Tg/WT volcano only

paper_results: Training increased mt-Nd3, Atp1a3, Rrad, Plac8, Cidea and Myh7 in WT but not Tg (S2.7.p5, S2.1.p2); GO of changed genes: muscle contraction terms (FIG S4B)
